clauses.why: The verses say he proclaimed that the house be built and that any of the people go up to build it; the clause overstates by saying the people go up.
clauses.english: proclaimed that the house of the LORD be built in Jerusalem
clauses.ukr: оголосив, щоб був збудований дім Господа в Єрусалимі
clauses.deu: ließ ausrufen, daß das Haus des HERRN zu Jerusalem gebaut werde
clauses.spa: hizo pasar pregón para que se edificase la casa del SEÑOR en Jerusalem

clauses.why: The verses say he brought out the vessels and they were delivered to Sheshbazzar; the 'temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken' is fine, but the chief fact can be shorter and EZR 5:14 alone covers both points.
clauses.english: brought out the temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken and gave them to Sheshbazzar
clauses.ukr: повиносив речі храму, які забрав Навуходоносор, і дав їх Шешбаццарові
clauses.deu: tat die Gefäße des Tempels heraus, die Nebukadnezar genommen hatte, und gab sie Sesbazar
clauses.spa: sacó los vasos del templo que Nabucodonosor había sacado, y los entregó a Sesbassar
